variables.input:
smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_VCENTER`
| fields name
| sort name asc

smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_DATACENTER`
| filter in(vcenter, array($vCenter))
| fields datacenter_name
| sort datacenter_name asc

smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_CLUSTER`
    | fieldsAdd dcid = arrayFirst(references[belongs_to.vmware_datacenter])
    | lookup [ smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_DATACENTER` | fields id, datacenter_name ], sourceField:dcid, lookupField:id, fields:{datacenter_name}
    | fields id, cluster_id, cluster_name, datacenter_name, vcenter
| filter in(vcenter, array($vCenter)) and in(datacenter_name, array($Datacenter))
| fields cluster_name
| append [ data record(cluster_name = "No Cluster") ]
| dedup cluster_name
| sort cluster_name asc

4.title: vCenters
4.query:
smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_VCENTER`
| filter in(name, array($vCenter))
| summarize count()

5.title: Clusters
5.query:
smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_CLUSTER`
    | fieldsAdd dcid = arrayFirst(references[belongs_to.vmware_datacenter])
    | lookup [ smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_DATACENTER` | fields id, datacenter_name ], sourceField:dcid, lookupField:id, fields:{datacenter_name}
    | fields id, cluster_id, cluster_name, datacenter_name, vcenter
| filterOut cluster_name == "No Cluster"
| filter in(vcenter, array($vCenter)) and in(datacenter_name, array($Datacenter)) and in(cluster_name, array($Cluster))
| summarize count()

6.title: Data Centers
6.query:
smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_DATACENTER`
| filter in(vcenter, array($vCenter)) and in(datacenter_name, array($Datacenter))
| summarize count()

7.title: Active VMs
7.query:
smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_VIRTUALMACHINE`
| filter (vm_connection_state == "connected") AND (vm_power_state == "poweredOn")
| filter in(vcenter, array($vCenter))
| summarize count()

8.title: Hosts in a Cluster
8.query:
smartscapeNodes "VMWARE_HOST"
| filter isNotNull(arrayFirst(references[runs_on.vmware_cluster]))
| fieldsAdd cid = arrayFirst(references[runs_on.vmware_cluster])
| lookup [ smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_CLUSTER`
    | fieldsAdd dcid = arrayFirst(references[belongs_to.vmware_datacenter])
    | lookup [ smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_DATACENTER` | fields id, datacenter_name ], sourceField:dcid, lookupField:id, fields:{datacenter_name}
    | fields id, cluster_id, cluster_name, datacenter_name, vcenter ], sourceField:cid, lookupField:id, fields:{cluster_name, datacenter_name}
| filter in(vcenter, array($vCenter)) and in(datacenter_name, array($Datacenter)) and in(cluster_name, array($Cluster))
| summarize count()

9.title: Standalone Hosts
9.query:
smartscapeNodes VMWARE_HOST
| filter isNull(arrayFirst(references[runs_on.vmware_cluster]))
| filter in(vcenter, array($vCenter))
| summarize count()

10.title: Connected/Disconnected Hosts
10.query:
smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_HOST`
| fieldsAdd cid = arrayFirst(references[runs_on.vmware_cluster])
| lookup [ smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_CLUSTER`
    | fieldsAdd dcid = arrayFirst(references[belongs_to.vmware_datacenter])
    | lookup [ smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_DATACENTER` | fields id, datacenter_name ], sourceField:dcid, lookupField:id, fields:{datacenter_name}
    | fields id, cluster_id, cluster_name, datacenter_name, vcenter ], sourceField:cid, lookupField:id, fields:{cluster_name}
| fieldsAdd cluster_name = coalesce(cluster_name, "No Cluster")
| filter in(vcenter, array($vCenter)) and in(cluster_name, array($Cluster))
| fields name, host_connected_state
| sort host_connected_state desc
| limit 20

11.title: Datastores
11.query:
smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_DATASTORE`
| fieldsAdd dcid = arrayFirst(references[belongs_to.vmware_datacenter])
| lookup [ smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_DATACENTER` | fields id, datacenter_name ], sourceField:dcid, lookupField:id, fields:{datacenter_name}
| filter in(vcenter, array($vCenter)) and in(datacenter_name, array($Datacenter))
| summarize count()

14.title: VMware Cluster Resource Details
14.query:
timeseries by: {`dt.smartscape.vmware_cluster` }, filter: { cluster.name != "No Cluster" and in(device.address, array($vCenter)) and in(cluster.name, array($Cluster)) },  {
  cpu_capacity = avg(vmware.cluster.cpu.capacity),
  cpu_used= avg(vmware.cluster.cpu.used),
  mem_capacity = avg(vmware.cluster.mem.capacity),
  mem_used= avg(vmware.cluster.mem.used),
  storage_capacity = avg(vmware.cluster.storage.capacity),
  storage_used= avg(vmware.cluster.storage.used)
}
| lookup [
    smartscapeNodes  `VMWARE_CLUSTER`
    | fields id, entity.name, cluster = record(entityId=id, displayName=entity.name, dim="dt.smartscape.vmware_cluster")
],
 sourceField: `dt.smartscape.vmware_cluster`,
 lookupField: id,
 fields: cluster
| lookup [ smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_CLUSTER`
    | fieldsAdd dcid = arrayFirst(references[belongs_to.vmware_datacenter])
    | lookup [ smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_DATACENTER` | fields id, datacenter_name ], sourceField:dcid, lookupField:id, fields:{datacenter_name}
    | fields id, cluster_id, cluster_name, datacenter_name, vcenter ], sourceField: `dt.smartscape.vmware_cluster`, lookupField: id, fields: {datacenter_name}
| filter in(datacenter_name, array($Datacenter))
| fieldsAdd 
  name = getNodeName(`dt.smartscape.vmware_cluster`),
  cpu_cap      = arrayLast(cpu_capacity),
  cpu_used     = arrayLast(cpu_used),
  mem_cap      = arrayLast(mem_capacity),
  mem_used     = arrayLast(mem_used),
  storage_cap  = arrayLast(storage_capacity),
  storage_used = arrayLast(storage_used)

| fieldsAdd entity_id = getNodeField(`dt.smartscape.vmware_cluster`, "id")
| fieldsAdd entity_url = concat("/ui/intent/dynatrace.infraops/view_smartscape_technology_details#{\"extensionNodeId\":\"", entity_id, "\"}")
| fieldsAdd Entity = concat("[", name, "]", "(", entity_url, ")")

| fields Entity, cpu_used, cpu_cap, mem_used, mem_cap, storage_used, storage_cap
| fieldsRename `Cluster`=Entity, 
               `CPU Used`=cpu_used,
               `CPU Capacity`=cpu_cap,
               `Memory Used`=mem_used,
               `Memory Capacity`=mem_cap,
               `Storage Used`=storage_used,
               `Storage Capacity`=storage_cap
| sort `CPU Used` desc
| limit 20

16.title: VMware Host Avg CPU %

17.title: CPU Usage
17.query:
timeseries average = avg(vmware.host.cpu.usage.average), by: { `dt.smartscape.vmware_host` }, filter: { in(device.address, array($vCenter)) and in(datacenter.name, array($Datacenter)) and in(cluster.name, array($Cluster)) }
| sort arrayAvg(average) desc
| fieldsAdd getNodeName(`dt.smartscape.vmware_host`), `dt.smartscape.vmware_host`
| limit 20

18.title: Memory Usage
18.query:
timeseries average = avg(vmware.host.mem.usage.average), by: { `dt.smartscape.vmware_host` }, filter: { in(device.address, array($vCenter)) and in(datacenter.name, array($Datacenter)) and in(cluster.name, array($Cluster)) }
| sort arrayAvg(average) desc
| fieldsAdd getNodeName(`dt.smartscape.vmware_host`), `dt.smartscape.vmware_host`
| limit 20

24.title: VMware Datastores
24.query:
timeseries { freeSpace = avg(vmware.datastore.freeSpace), capacity = avg(vmware.datastore.capacity) }, by: { `dt.smartscape.vmware_datastore`}, filter: { in(device.address, array($vCenter)) }
| fieldsAdd used = 100 - (100 * (freeSpace[] / capacity[] ))
| fieldsAdd used = arrayLast(used)
| sort used desc
| join [ timeseries freeSpace = avg(vmware.datastore.freeSpace), by: { `dt.smartscape.vmware_datastore` }, filter: { in(device.address, array($vCenter)) }
       | fieldsAdd freeSpace = arrayLast(freeSpace) ], on: { `dt.smartscape.vmware_datastore` }, fields: {freeSpace, `dt.smartscape.vmware_datastore`, interval, timeframe}, kind: outer
| join [ timeseries capacity = avg(vmware.datastore.capacity), by: { `dt.smartscape.vmware_datastore` }, filter: { in(device.address, array($vCenter)) }
       | fieldsAdd capacity = arrayLast(capacity) ], on: { `dt.smartscape.vmware_datastore` }, fields: {capacity, `dt.smartscape.vmware_datastore`, interval, timeframe}, kind: outer
| lookup [ smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_DATASTORE`
    | fieldsAdd dcid = arrayFirst(references[belongs_to.vmware_datacenter])
    | lookup [ smartscapeNodes `VMWARE_DATACENTER` | fields id, datacenter_name ], sourceField:dcid, lookupField:id, fields:{datacenter_name}
    | fields id, datacenter_name ], sourceField: `dt.smartscape.vmware_datastore`, lookupField: id, fields: {datacenter_name}
| filter in(datacenter_name, array($Datacenter))
| fieldsAdd getNodeName(`dt.smartscape.vmware_datastore`), alias: Name

| fieldsAdd entity_id = getNodeField(`dt.smartscape.vmware_datastore`, "id")
| fieldsAdd entity_url = concat("/ui/intent/dynatrace.infraops/view_smartscape_technology_details#{\"extensionNodeId\":\"", entity_id, "\"}")
| fieldsAdd Entity = concat("[", Name, "]", "(", entity_url, ")")

| fields Entity, freeSpace, capacity, used
| fieldsRename `Datastore Name`=Entity, `Free Space`=freeSpace, `Capacity`=capacity, `Used %`=used
| sort `Used %` desc
| limit 20

27.query:
fetch logs
| filter(isNotNUll(vcenter.address))
| filter in(vcenter.address, array($vCenter))
| fields timestamp, `vcenter.address`, `host.name`, content 
| fieldsRename Time=timestamp, vCenter=vcenter.address, Host=host.name, Message=content 
| sort Time desc
| limit 20
